ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 dark-to-light pixel ratio across visible ventral surfaces, with high-intensity white streaks against a low-intensity dark gray/black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains vertical linear white striations in the central region and a horizontal series of white circular spots at the base. Right lobe features a dense, irregular white mottled patch concentrated in the upper-medial region near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jagged notches, with a significant inward recession of the boundary mid-lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a standard convex sweep. The right lobe displays a truncated, irregular trajectory due to severe edge erosion and tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A linear constellation of high-contrast white circular spots is located at the ventral peduncle junction of the left lobe. A cluster of reddish-brown and white pixel anomalies is localized at the distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip and trailing edge of the right lobe show extensive tissue loss and irregular morphology, accompanied by visible reddish-brown biological lesions or scabbing.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique row of 5-6 discrete white circular markers aligned horizontally at the insertion point of the left fluke lobe.
